title: Dirty State + Save Clarity

files_changed.rationale: Pure read-side helper module. Classifies workspace_state + runtime_summary + save_state into a 6-state machine (saved / dirty / unsaved / needs_rerun / stale / unknown). Returns a frozen DirtyState dataclass. NO persistence calls, NO mutation, NO imports from app.persistence / app.services / app.waterfall / app.construction / app.debt / app.tax / app.depreciation / app.idc.

Jinja partial that renders nothing when dirty_state is missing, otherwise renders exactly ONE badge with the pre-classified label / tone. Reuses the existing badge vocabulary (badge-pass / badge-warn / badge-dirty / badge-blocked). NO autosave. NO mutation. NO backend calls.

Helper unit tests pinning: state vocabulary (6 entries), classification matrix (7 combinations), read-only accessors, helper-does-not-mutate invariant, no-persistence-calls invariant, pre-classified fields.
Template partial tests pinning: renders nothing when context missing, renders exactly ONE badge per state, applies the correct tone class, exposes data-* attributes for downstream consumers.
Factory safety tests pinning: determinism, no forbidden imports, no feature flag enablement, rc1 frozen, no schema changes, no autosave, factory projects safe (TUHO / Oborovo inputs unchanged).
8-section design + change doc with goal, scope, state machine table, file change list, self-review findings, pre-merge audit, hard no-go list, stop-after-report contract.

self_review_findings: Initial draft proposed auto-wiring the partial into app/templates/index.html. Mitigation: the partial is intentionally NOT wired into index.html in this phase. The helper is exported and the partial is in place, but the wiring step is deferred to a future phase that has explicit go-ahead for live UI integration. This phase ships the building blocks only.

The 'stale' state is reserved for future timestamp-aware logic (e.g. comparing last_saved_at vs last_run_at). In this phase, the conservative classifier treats 'clean + prior run + save record' as 'saved' and never invents a 'stale' classification.
The helper is exposed as a pure function with no side effects, so it is safe to call from any context (partial wiring, future JS, future tests, future API).

stop_after_report_contract.rationale: 25B-4 ships the dirty-state building blocks only. The partial is not wired into index.html in this phase. Future wiring requires explicit go-ahead.
